tools.name: get_consulting_overview
tools.description: Read how Rich Steinmetz helps medium and large businesses connect APIs, put AI to work, and improve business software. Use this to check whether the consulting is a fit, see examples of past work, or find links to Rich’s profile and projects.

tools.name: get_solution_definition_call
tools.description: Read the published price, payment terms, and Google Calendar link for Rich’s Solution Definition Call. Use this when someone asks what the call covers, how much it costs, when they would pay, or how to pick a time. The link opens the booking page.

tools.name: read_public_page
tools.description: Read the full Markdown text of a named public page on richsteinmetz.com. Use this to answer a question with the site’s exact language or to retrieve a source URL for a citation.
